desc: The Browning Buck Mark Black Label Contour Pistol is a great looking target pistol. It has a high-strength and lightweight polymer frame and also wears a post-modern angled serrated G-10 grip set which provides outstanding traction between your hand and the gun, even when wet. You'll appreciate the three-dot combat sights as well; durable and highly visible for quick target acquisition. The skeletonized trigger and commander hammer provide a custom look and feel, and compliment the beavertail grip safety and extended ambidextrous thumb safety. The 1913 Picatinny rail on the dust cover is placed for the addition of a light or laser aiming device, rounding out all the features you would expect from a custom buck mark, but available in a factory gun.
